Nina (People Ops): Quick heads-up: next week we're running a 'Quiet Onsite' pilot at the SF hub to support heads-down work and reduce ping interruptions. Please read if you're booking desks or planning visits. :shushing_face:

Nina (People Ops): TL;DR: quiet hours 9:30-15:30 in designated zones (north wing & focus rooms), visitor prereg required 24h, reduced communal music & no boomboxes, and low-volume catering allowed. Booking links: desks https://redwood.internal/desks and guest prereg https://redwood.internal/forms/visitor-prereg

Omar (Facilities): We'll mark focus rooms and post signs. Please respect quiet zones; phone calls should be in quiet booths or the cafe area. Security desk will remind guests at badge pickup.

Sam (Eng): Will the focus rooms be reservable for team meetings?

Nina (People Ops): Short meetings ok but prioritize solo work. For collaborative sessions use the collaboration wing or reserve a standard conference room. Add "quiet-pilot" tag to bookings if it's heads-down time.

Luca (Sales): If I have a customer demo during quiet hours can I request a noise exception?

Nina (People Ops): Yes, exceptions for demos are allowed; please note it on the prereg form and include expected noise (e.g., A/V). We'll route you to an A/V room to limit disruption.

IT Support: Note for contractors: temporary wifi accounts issued only for preregistered visitors. Submit requests 48h in advance.

Concierge Bot: Reminder: pilot dates Mon 10/4 - Fri 10/8. We will evaluate usage and feedback at the end of the week. Questions -> #people-ops or DM Nina. :memo:
